title: Lemmings Paintball: readiness for a separate port
objective: Clean, idiomatic MSVC 4.00 reconstruction with understood Windows behavior, explicit format and ownership contracts, and clear platform boundaries. Perfection and 100% matching are not requirements.
status: Stage 2 of 5: behavior contracts and ownership. Substantial validation and platform-boundary work remains. No SDL3 dependency or backend belongs in this repository.

current_position.assessment: Achievable as a port-ready Windows reference. This is an engineering judgment, not a claim of runtime equivalence or a completion-date estimate.
completed_foundation: Initial direct-include and include-order sweep; formatter policy and reviewed SDK exceptions recorded.
Original Windows build, linker routes and canonical matching workflow established.
Packet assembly and scalar/socket header codecs have reproducible original/rebuilt checks.
current_position.current_work: Document message-buffer ownership, initialization and callback timing. Finish a bounded deferred-send lifetime trace; then move to resource formats and core simulation behavior.
current_position.not_yet_established: Reusable resource/core-simulation fixtures, complete service replacement contracts, representative gameplay/media/network lifecycle traces, and the external-port handoff package.
current_position.progress_measure: Stage and deliverable completion. Exact/Effective scores remain source-validation gates; they are not percentages of port readiness. Stage 2 does not mean 40% complete.

delivery_stages.name: Source hygiene foundation
delivery_stages.status: initial sweep complete; maintain during changes
delivery_stages.exit: Direct dependencies and include policy established; necessary ABI/SDK exceptions recorded. No further global cosmetic sweep required.

delivery_stages.name: Formats, ownership and core behavior
delivery_stages.exit: Contracts and representative reference cases for resource/packet formats, buffer lifetimes, initialization/failure, fixed-point movement/RNG and timer wrap. Native-only layouts clearly separated from serialized data.

delivery_stages.name: Platform replacement contracts
delivery_stages.exit: For each required service, identify its caller-facing operations, inputs/results, state ownership and event/completion order. Cover window/input/time/files, software-pixel presentation, audio/MIDI/AVI and transport. Keep the Windows implementation here.

delivery_stages.name: Representative integration validation
delivery_stages.status: pending; isolated codec checks already available
delivery_stages.exit: Reproducible reference traces for menu-to-level-to-exit, selection/movement/shooting, palette/clipping changes, audio/media transitions and multiplayer connect/send/disconnect. Resolve failures that block these scenarios; explicitly record untested edges.

delivery_stages.name: Handoff to a separate port
delivery_stages.exit: Component replacement map, format/lifetime/service contracts, fixture commands and provenance, build instructions and a bounded known-limitations list. A port author can implement the platform layer without rediscovering these contracts. No SDL source or dependency added here.

next_deliverables: Finish deferred-send lifetime tracing: queue posting, consumption, completion and shutdown; document which object owns each buffer at those boundaries.
Make MOG directory/resource parsing checks reproducible and record serialized widths, bounds, allocation and lock/release behavior.
Capture representative fixed-point movement/RNG and timer-wrap cases; identify event-pump ordering needed by a replacement platform.
Use those contracts to make focused type, ownership and platform-boundary improvements; retain the whole-executable source-batch metric gate.
practical_stopping_rules: A documented, evidenced Windows ABI requirement is an accepted constraint. Every legacy cast, type or construct need not disappear.
Do not pursue Exact 100 solely for a register choice, equivalent instruction encoding or compiler-context effect.
The existing packet primitive checks are sufficient for their stated scope. Extend them when a concrete failure, source change or newly discovered contract requires it.
Use representative normal, boundary and failure cases; do not attempt exhaustive state-space or universal equivalence proofs.
Broaden validation for observed failures or unresolved material behavior. Otherwise complete the deliverable and move to the next stage.
Port readiness requires the stage exit criteria and known blockers to be addressed, not perfection or a 100% matching score.

qualifications: Include counts identify coupling, not 196 independent defects.
453 functions without Effective 100 are investigation candidates, not 453 proven behavioral bugs.
No complete runtime equivalence suite exists in the reviewed workflow; matching is static evidence.

principles: Original Windows x86 remains behavioral and ABI authority; Mac symbols support names/types.
Each cleanup needs a concrete readability, ownership, type, dependency or portability benefit.
Preserve the MSVC 4.00 reference target and its original layout/calling convention. Portable runtime objects may need different layouts.
Preserve narrowing, wrap, signedness, access order and allocation failure behavior; assess changes explicitly.
Retain current source-batch metric rule unless the user approves an evidence-backed exception. No score-driven source permutations.
Tests target meaningful behavior contracts. One appropriate verification pass per batch; broaden only for a new concern.
Select source matching targets through triage_targets.py and read their reconstruction memory before editing.

milestones.status: initial sweep complete; maintain and review exceptions
milestones.work: Complete direct include/forward-declaration coverage. Group each implementation header first, then CRT/system headers, then project headers. Preserve required Windows SDK and macro prerequisites. Make formatting preserve that policy. Keep complete types at deletion and layout sites.
milestones.completion: Touched headers provide their own required declarations; implementation files include their direct providers; source/build checks pass; compiler-context effects measured across the full executable.
milestones.next_step: Keep direct dependencies explicit as source changes. Revisit reviewed IWYU exceptions only with provider/type evidence; preserve SDK prerequisites and the formatter policy. Next substantive work: fixed-format contracts and reusable behavior fixtures.
milestones.completed: Direct-dependency cleanup across transport, frontend, engine/platform and GameView/Gameplay; remaining CRT/system include groups moved before project headers. Own implementation header remains first. Formatter preserves deliberate groups and order.

reviewed_exception.declaration: timeGetTime: C linkage, unsigned long return, __stdcall, no arguments
reviewed_exception.reason: Original ResendCritical calls an import thunk directly. The available mmsystem.h marks the API dllimport and compiles an indirect IAT call.
reviewed_exception.measured_trial: WindowsTypes.h plus mmsystem.h, removing the hand declaration: Exact -90 bytes, Effective -69 bytes; no gains. Full executable report, routes and original-byte denominator checked on c0607b60.
reviewed_exception.decision: Trial reverted. Keep this ABI declaration under the current source-batch rule; no compiler controls added to alter import lowering. A separate port can use its platform clock interface.

milestones.status: network scalar/header contract checked; other formats pending
milestones.work: Inventory fixed-format data separately from runtime classes. Specify exact field widths, padding, endian order, sentinels and ownership. Audit bool=int, unsigned long, pointer fields and enum widths before any modern or 64-bit build.
milestones.concrete_blocker: CNetworkMessage::Get(unsigned long&) writes four bytes. A wider unsigned long would leave part of the result uninitialized. MogDirectoryEntry also uses unsigned long and sizeof for an on-disk stride.
milestones.completion: Representative original resource and packet bytes decode and encode identically using explicit format widths; original-build layouts remain verified; host pointers and runtime state are not treated as serialized structures.

milestones.status: message-buffer base contract recorded; broader ownership audit needed
milestones.work: Trace allocation/free pairs, borrowed versus owned storage, initialization paths and shutdown order in resource arenas, queues, surfaces and sound. Preserve native failure behavior, access timing and destruction order. Recover typed ownership and shared operations where original x86 supports them.
milestones.completion: Owners and lifetimes are clear at interfaces; failed initialization and repeated shutdown have reference-backed behavior; no redundant parallel ownership mechanisms.

milestones.status: packet assembly and message codec checks reusable; other fixtures pending
milestones.work: Create a small, deliberate set of reference fixtures: fixed-point movement and RNG, timer wrap, event ordering, resource parsing, palette/clipping pixels and network messages. Add runtime scenarios for menu-to-level flow, selection, movement, shooting, media transitions and multiplayer connection lifecycle.
milestones.completion: Reference input/output or state traces are reproducible, with provenance from original execution or cited x86. Each relevant cleanup/port change can be checked against these observations. Broader unobserved behavior stays explicitly unverified.
milestones.existing_evidence: Packet assembly and scalar/socket header checks reproduce original/rebuilt/model results. Shared x86 fixture support avoids duplicate emulator setup. Archived MOG directory-parser, text-paint and resource-lock fixtures still need reusable forms.

milestones.work: Separate required game services from Win32 implementation: clocks, event delivery, locks, files/paths, installation discovery, diagnostics and window lifecycle. Preserve existing queue ordering and use the smallest useful interfaces.
concrete_blockers: PumpEvents orders mouse processing, network queue draining, Win32 dispatch, input queue processing, resource aging and cursor processing.
CurrentMilliTimer uses the Win32 millisecond clock. Document 32-bit elapsed-time, wrap and time-origin assumptions before another clock implementation replaces it in a separate port.
CCritical embeds CRITICAL_SECTION and calls its API inline. This layout belongs to the Windows reference implementation.
milestones.completion: Required services and their ordering are explicit; Windows handles, SDK types and inline synchronization are confined to understood reference interfaces. Avoid abstractions that only move existing coupling.

milestones.work: Preserve software rasterization, palette changes, clipping, depth buffers and integer coordinates. Clarify the window/display presentation boundary and document frame and input-coordinate contracts for a separate port.
milestones.completion: Representative indexed pixels and palette transitions have reference fixtures; presentation, focus/fullscreen and scaling contracts are clear enough for a separate backend implementation.

milestones.work: Recover sample conversions, voice ownership, volume/pan/frequency mapping, looping and completion timing. Document MIDI and AVI state/notification behavior and actual asset formats for a separate port to choose implementations.
milestones.completion: Audio conversion fixtures and media state/event traces established; backend obligations and asset/codec requirements explicit. No SDL, synth or decoder dependency added here.

milestones.status: packet codecs checked; message-buffer ownership contract recorded; lifecycle work remains
milestones.work: Recover packet layout, byte order, sequence arithmetic, discovery, retry and disconnect contracts. Trace pointer-derived connection IDs and their identity/lifetime/echo semantics; document the stable 32-bit token requirement for a separate portable implementation.
milestones.completion: Packet fixtures and connection lifecycle traces established; protocol compatibility and pointer-token assumptions explicit. Original Windows behavior and ABI preserved here.

milestones.work: Keep the original build reproducible. Identify compiler/runtime ABI machinery and separate its responsibilities from game behavior. Provide source boundaries, format contracts, fixture provenance and remaining uncertainties for a separate port.
milestones.completion: A separate port has a concrete component replacement map and reproducible behavior references. This repository gains no SDL dependency or backend.
milestones.open_item: Establish the separate port repository and its integration contract before work there. No port source or dependency is introduced here.

readiness_definition: Important behavior contracts captured and meaningful uncertainties listed.
Core types, ownership and initialization understandable; required platform services explicit.
Native ABI/compiler runtime responsibilities isolated and documented so a separate port can implement its own runtime.
Representative gameplay, rendering, resource, audio/media and protocol cases have reference evidence and reproducible fixtures.
Original Windows build and matching remain verified; SDL implementation belongs elsewhere.
No requirement for every function to match 100% or every legacy construct to disappear.
evidence_limits: Initial, focused inventory; other porting obstacles may remain.
Static matching supports source hypotheses; it does not establish complete runtime equivalence.
Source paths and named operations are evidence pointers. Read the original Windows x86 before changing behavior or ABI.
Baseline counts describe the recorded commit, not automatically the current working tree.

scope.this_repository: Windows reconstruction and behavior reference; prepare clean source and explicit contracts for a separate port.
scope.external_port: SDL3 dependency, SDL backend implementation, and portable application integration belong in a separate codebase.
scope.user_clarification: SDL3 must not be part of this codebase.

next_reference_contract.subject: Deferred send completion and borrowed message lifetimes
confirmed: Scalar and socket header codecs now have reproducible byte and access-order fixtures; see docs/message-codec.json.
OpenDataStream allocates payload capacity plus a 16-byte header on first open of unowned storage; invokes virtual AddHeader/AddData.
CopyDataStream replaces buffer/cursors and invokes virtual AddHeader/AddData without changing the ownership flag.
Initialization, open/reuse, copy, set and destruction contracts recorded in docs/message-buffer-lifetime.json.
Destruction can release an owned buffer after a 2000ms timeout while pendingSendCount remains nonzero.
remaining: Trace queue consumption and transport completion through shutdown; identify when queued message and borrowed buffer pointers stop being used.
Prove ownership flags and lifetime constraints across nested-message and broadcast call sequences; direct call-site review alone is insufficient.
Establish allocator/new-handler failure behavior and concrete callback effects before introducing failure handling.
Separate 32-bit wire values from host unsigned long width without changing the reference ABI.
next_reference_contract.qualification: Controlled codec aliases expose native access timing. Actual caller alias reachability and complete ownership paths remain unproved.
